message.content:
Here are some top-rated sushi spots in Los Angeles that consistently receive rave reviews:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Highlights |
|------------|--------------|------------|
| **Sushi Gen** | Little Tokyo | Classic omakase, fresh fish, intimate setting |
| **KazuNori** | West Hollywood | Creative rolls, excellent service, great happy hour |
| **Matsuhisa** | Beverly Hills | Fusion of Japanese & Peruvian flavors, upscale vibe |
| **Sushi Zo** | Downtown | Omakase experience with a focus on seasonal ingredients |
| **Umi** | Santa Monica | Contemporary take on traditional sushi, waterfront view |

If you’re looking for something more casual or budget-friendly, consider **Sushi Taro** (Hollywood) or **Sushi Katsu** (Beverly Grove). All of these places have strong reputations for quality, freshness, and service. Enjoy your meal!
